business_problem: Dollarito wanted to lend responsibly to people with low or no credit history using richer behavioral and banking data, but it lacked the secure, compliant and scalable infrastructure needed for AI-powered credit evaluation.
solution_summary: Dollarito worked with IBM to build its lending platform on IBM Cloud for Financial Services and the IBM watsonx portfolio. The architecture combines compliant cloud infrastructure with containerized operations and a data-mesh approach so the company can analyze banking transactions, behavioral signals and economic factors instead of relying only on traditional credit scores. IBM Cloud for Financial Services provides the secure and auditable operating environment, including the controls needed to demonstrate regulatory compliance, while watsonx supports the AI and foundation-model capabilities behind smarter lending decisions. Strict audit trails and access controls were designed into the platform from the start so Dollarito could innovate without sacrificing trust. The result is an AI-enabled credit evaluation and loan-processing environment that shortens approvals, automates disbursement and collections, and gives underserved borrowers access to decisions built on a broader view of repayment capability.
